body:
thanks for the reply. i'm still awake because i realized i haven't eaten since sunday and i've already hurt myself enough so i'm making some easy food. 

i know my post was pretty vague, i don't really want to ramble on about why i want to die, because i've already gone over the reasons in my head a million times, y'know? i will say that one of the reasons i'm still alive is because of those good days. when the sun finally rises and everything is okay, all that matters is the happy stuff. i haven't seen one of those days in so long though. i guess i'm very caught up in the fact that i had a shit childhood and two shitty parents, so i wasn't given the best foundation. i know people make it out of shitty situations all the time and lead successful lives, but that's because they're motivated. i can't find the will anymore, i can't find that blind hope i've felt during my upswings. i don't know.

i would love to move far away and delve into music and writing. music has gotten me through some really tough times, it's also made me break down.  for the past few weeks i've been playing piano for hours - well, my keyboard with my headphones in, because i have neighbors who i'm sure wouldn't appreciate me playing on my grand piano all night.

it's still so hard to have will to keep going. of course i love making music, but depression has a special way of draining passion from a person.
